testimonials.name: Tunde Adeyemi
testimonials.role: Bought a plot at Emerald Ridge
testimonials.quote: I had been shown three other estates where nobody could produce a survey on the day. Here the documents were on the table before I asked, and the plot I walked was the plot on the plan.

testimonials.name: Ngozi Eze
testimonials.role: Bought a home at Sabon Lugbe Court
testimonials.quote: We paid over fourteen months and moved in the week after the final instalment cleared. No renegotiation, no extra charges at handover.

testimonials.name: Yusuf Danjuma
testimonials.role: Bought two plots at Cornerstone Gardens
testimonials.quote: They told me plainly which plots had excision granted and which did not, and priced them differently. That is the first time anyone has done that with me.
